t: A ready-built research robot that maps rooms and drives itself with ROS 2.
steps: Buy a TurtleBot 4 or TurtleBot 4 Lite from a distributor such as RobotShop or Robotics Center.
Read the free TurtleBot 4 User Manual and check which ROS 2 version your robot runs.
Install Ubuntu and ROS 2 Humble or Jazzy on your own computer.
Update the Create 3 base firmware to match your ROS 2 version.
Connect the robot to your Wi-Fi network with the manual's setup steps.
Drive the robot with the keyboard teleop example.
Run the SLAM example to build a map of a room.
Try the navigation example and send the robot to a spot on your map.
meta: Open Board. From $1,465. A few stores.
